althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: Critique of Political Economy in the 1844 Manuscripts
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: This chapter addresses the structure of early humanist critique, differing from existing political philosophy entries, and is retained independently.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: Critique and Science in Capital
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: KUHN addresses scientific revolutions; this chapter addresses how the critique of political economy generates a new object, and remains independent.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: Conclusion: From Humanist Critique to Scientific Problematic
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Connected to ALTHUSSER master routing to indicate when critical language shifts from moral denunciation to structural analysis.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: The Process of Exposition of Capital: The Starting Point of the Analysis of Wealth
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: This chapter specifically addresses the difference between a conceptual starting point and an empirical starting point, and is not merged with other entries.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: Analysis of the Commodity and the Appearance of Contradiction
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Adjacent to GIDDENS's structural contradiction, but this chapter focuses on conceptual contradiction within the commodity form and is retained independently.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: Analysis of Value: How Concepts Work
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: This chapter serves theoretical modeling and economic institutional reasoning, and is retained as an independent entry.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: The Object of Capital: Introduction
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Merged into ALTHUSSER routing as a methodological reminder of 'object first.'

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: Marx and His Discoveries
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: This chapter addresses how theoretical discoveries open up new objects; adjacent to KUHN but not merged.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: The Merits of Classical Economics
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Used for writing the productive limitations of old theories; not merged with general paradigm entries.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: The Errors of Classical Economics: Outline of a Concept of Historical Time
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Linkable with GIDDENS's time-space change; retained here for Althusser's structural prompt on non-linear historical time.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: Marxism Is Not a Historicism
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Provides anti-historicist error prevention and is not merged with REV or MOVEMENT.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: The Epistemological Propositions of Capital
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: KUHN discusses scientific communities, whereas this chapter discusses the epistemological structure of theoretical practice and remains independent.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: The Object of Political Economy
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Helps define the theoretical object of the economic field, differing from PROTCAP or BOURDIEU capital, and is retained independently.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: Marx's Critique
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Adjacent to the history of critique in P2, but focuses on the mechanism of mature critique and is retained independently.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: Marx's Immense Theoretical Revolution
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Linkable with KUHN's paradigm revolution, while retaining Althusser's structural causality and orientation toward the science of history.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: On the "Ideal Average" and the Forms of Transition
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Connects theoretical pure types with historical hybrid forms; retained independently to prevent mechanical template application in worldbuilding.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: From Periodization to the Modes of Production
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: REV addresses stages of revolution, whereas this chapter addresses the concept of mode of production and methods of periodization; retained independently.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: The Elements of the Structure and Their History
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Provides the component table of modes of production and is not merged with BOURDIEU's field/capital.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: On Reproduction
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Linkable with GIDDENS's institutional reproduction; retained here for the specialized mechanism of reproducing the conditions of a mode of production.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: Elements for a Theory of Transition
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Connected to REV and STASIS routing to explain structural transitions and non-synchronous changes beyond revolution.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: Presentation of Capital by Marx Himself
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Serves textual structure and plan analysis; retained independently.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: The Articulations of Capital
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Addresses the hierarchical articulation of theoretical objects and is not merged with general methodology.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: The Theoretical Field of Volumes I and II and the Absent Place of Competition
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Emphasizes how an absent object can be precisely located; suited for retention within the symptomatic reading module.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: Definition of the Object of the Second Part of Articulation II
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Establet's textual-structure refinement entry; retained independently to support complex institutional deconstruction.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: Study of the Sub-articulations of the Second Part of Articulation II
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Specifically constrains nested analysis; retained independently.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: Definition of Articulation II
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Serves as the structural-definition culmination of P6 and is not merged into other modules.

althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.title: Conclusion: Reading Capital as a Structural Diagram
althusser_readingcapital_merge_log.note: Merged into ALTHUSSER master control as a structural-diagrammatic mode of reading complex theoretical texts.
